I tried both. Adding the **javascript** tag right while saving feels more natural to me — it's all one motion: paste, pick a tag from the ones I've used, save, done. The after-saving version works fine too, but it's an extra step once the link is already sitting there.

So I'd go with tags while saving. And I'm glad to see it suggesting the tags I've used before — that's just what I wanted so I don't keep making up new names for the same thing.
